subject.title: fix(install): bound download_file curl with connect and max-time limits

question: Should the installers impose a 10-second deadline on DNS and connection handshakes, or retain main’s current connection behavior while only preserving the established 30-second low-speed transfer policy?
rationale: curl defines the proposed connection timeout as covering DNS and transport/TLS setup, making the value a user-visible installer reliability policy rather than a mechanical refactor.

options.title: Preserve established behavior
options.body: Keep the current 30-second low-speed grace and do not add a new connection-phase cutoff until an owner selects and documents one.

options.title: Adopt a 10-second connection cutoff
options.body: Accept that slow DNS, proxy, TCP, or TLS setup can fail after 10 seconds and add focused proof and release-note context for that new installer policy.

recommendation.title: Preserve established behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the current 30-second low-speed grace and do not add a new connection-phase cutoff until an owner selects and documents one.

likelyOwner.reason: Current scripts ownership requires the required history/CODEOWNERS lookup before assigning an individual.
